definition: Deliverability is a storage facility's ability to withdraw gas for sale, and it depends on how much gas is currently held in the facility.
core_idea: Deliverability rises with the facility's fill level and is highest when the facility is nearly full.
key_points: Deliverability depends on the current amount of gas in the facility.
Deliverability is at its highest when the facility is nearly full.
relationships: Inverse relationship to Injection Capacity — deliverability peaks exactly when injection capacity is lowest.
